chunks: And it is narrated that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Indeed, the most despicable of your dead are the unmarried."

key_terms.رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; indicating a reported transmission
key_terms.مَوْتَاكُمُ: your dead ones; those among you who have died

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about dying unmarried?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم a strong censure of remaining unmarried. It highlights the virtue of marriage and presents unmarried death as a blameworthy state within the social and moral framework of the narration.
